description: Opens and reads web pages on the Mac. Claude's own pages open in Latchkey's own browser, in the background, where nobody sees them: while the Mac is unlocked without the owner's Safari sign-ins (type a saved sign-in with logins_fill, or move the page into Safari with sign_in_again), while it is locked with a copy of Safari's sign-ins (a site may then sign the owner out in Safari). Only when the owner asks to see what Claude does, pass show_in_safari with url: the page opens in a background Safari tab of Claude's in the owner's front window, signed in as the owner (the owner's front tab stays in front; the owner clicks the tab to watch). Each answer says which. With url: opens that page in a new page of Claude's own and answers with its name, like p4k2; with url and page, opens it in that page. Pass page on every later call (other chats may have pages open too; with several open, a call without page is refused with the list). tabs: lists every tab of every Safari window of the owner's, each with a reference like 4213.2 (window, then tab), and Claude's own pages. With tab: reads that tab of the owner's, in the background (name it on each call that should use it). With back: goes back. With nothing else: reads the page. Answers with the page's text and the links, buttons, and fields on it, each with a reference like e12 for browser_act. Long pages come in parts; pass offset to read on. screenshot: shows the page as an image. sign_in_again: when a page of Claude's in Latchkey's own browser is signed out but needs the owner's sign-in: while the Mac is unlocked, moves it into a Safari tab of Claude's at the same address; while locked, takes Safari's cookies again and loads the page again. A page's confirm or prompt that Claude didn't answer in advance waits for Claude: the answer says what it asks, and browser_act action dialog answers it. A page that is a file (a PDF) isn't shown: save it with browser_act download.

back.description: Go back to the previous page

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

offset.description: Read the page from this character

page.description: Claude's page to use, by the name an earlier answer gave, like p4k2

screenshot.description: Show the page as an image

show_in_safari.description: With url, only when the owner asked to see what Claude does: open the page in a Safari tab of Claude's the owner can watch (Mac unlocked)

sign_in_again.description: Claude's page is signed out but needs the owner's sign-in: move it into Safari (unlocked) or take Safari's cookies again (locked)

tab.description: Use this tab of the owner's: its reference from the tab list, like 4213.2

tabs.description: List every tab of every Safari window, and Claude's own pages

name: browser_look
title: Read the Web
